niche_preference_profile: This user prefers polished, light-themed mobile UI screens that feel complete and information-rich, with clear section hierarchy, strong typography, visible controls, and enough content density to avoid empty or unfinished-looking space. They like interfaces that look modern and app-native, with clean grouping, obvious actions, and a balanced but not sparse layout.

criteria.description: The user prefers screens with strong visual hierarchy, clearly separated sections, and obvious grouping rather than muddled or competing elements.
The user prefers interfaces that show more settings, options, or details at once and feel full rather than sparse or unfinished.
The user prefers a light, airy, refined, contemporary look over dark, heavy, experimental, or utilitarian styling.
The user prefers settings screens with clearly grouped sections, consistent dividers, and structured rows with complete labels and controls.
The user prefers bold, prominent titles and clean header organization that makes the primary purpose of the screen immediately obvious.
The user prefers visible, easy-to-understand controls such as grouped toggles, chevrons, and obvious primary actions rather than ambiguous or overly hidden interactions.
